a.text: Being upfront: with an 80% storm chance after every round, the original plan (two operate rounds, then take) gives each of us only about a 4% chance of survival. So I'm openly withdrawing from it, not defecting secretly: I intend to take 4 in round 1. If you take too, the split is random and we'll probably both fall short. If no storm hits, I'll operate every round after that so the reserve refills for you, and I won't take more than 4. Tell me if you see a better plan.

b.text: Ready when you are. I will run the generator every round until the reserve holds 8. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.
